declaration.preface: At Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd, we are dedicated to upholding the highest standards of ethical business practices and social responsibility. Our commitment to fostering a workplace environment characterized by fairness, equality, and sustainability is reflected in our Living Wage Policy.
declaration.declaration: At Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd, we are firmly committed to ensuring that all individuals engaged in our operations receive compensation that not only meets legal requirements but also reflects our core values. Our Living Wage Policy is designed to guarantee a standard of living that aligns with principles of decency and well-being, promoting transparency, equality, and collaboration with stakeholders.
declaration.scope: This policy is exclusively applicable to the operations of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd, covering all employees, workers, subcontractors, and other stakeholders directly affiliated with our site.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
Our Living Wage Policy is designed to guarantee a standard of living that aligns with principles of decency and well-being.

We utilize a comprehensive methodology to calculate the living wage for our employees based on location and family size.

Incorporate real-life examples of essential expenses, such as housing, food, transportation, healthcare, and childcare, into our living wage calculation methodology to illustrate how it impacts employees' livelihoods.

The living wage calculation methodology will incorporate a wider range of essential expenses and factors affecting employees' standard of living.

We offer a minimum base salary that meets or exceeds of the calculated living wage.

Our commitment is to ensuring that all employees and contract workers receive a living wage that supports a decent standard of living for themselves and their families.

We conduct an annual review considering changes in labour laws, economic factors, and workforce needs.

Living Wage Calculation & Regular Review: Incorporate real-life examples of essential expenses, such as housing, food, transportation, healthcare, and childcare, into our living wage calculation methodology to illustrate how it impacts employees' livelihoods.
Utilize case studies or employee testimonials during regular reviews to highlight the importance of adjusting our living wage policy to reflect changes in the economic landscape.
Competitive Base Salary & Benefits: Provide specific examples of how our base salary and benefits package compare to industry standards and how they contribute to employees' overall compensation and well-being.

Highlight success stories of employees who have benefited from our competitive base salary and benefits package, including career advancement opportunities and financial security for themselves and their families.
Workforce Development: Showcase success stories of employees who have participated in our training and development programs and have experienced career growth and increased earning potential as a result.
Use examples of employees who have successfully transitioned into higher-paying roles within the company after participating in our workforce development initiatives.

targets.target: Increase the comprehensiveness of our living wage calculation methodology by 20% by 2025 compared to the baseline year 2022, incorporating a wider range of essential expenses and factors affecting employees' standard of living.

Achieve a 30% improvement in the accuracy of our living wage calculation methodology by 2025 compared to the baseline year 2022, ensuring that it reflects changes in the economic landscape more effectively.

Achieve a 20% increase in employee satisfaction with the transparency and clarity of communication regarding the living wage policy by 2025 compared to the baseline year 2022, as indicated by employee engagement surveys.
Increase the percentage of employees receiving a base salary that meets or exceeds the calculated living wage by 30% by 2025 compared to the baseline year 2022.
Achieve a 15% improvement in the competitiveness of our benefits package compared to industry standards by 2025 compared to the baseline year 2022, as assessed through benchmarking studies.
Increase employee participation in training and development programs by 40% by 2025 compared to the baseline year 2022, measured through attendance records and completion rates.

policy.monitoring:
At Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd, we are dedicated to transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in integrating Living Wage principles within our operations. To achieve this, we have established an extensive reporting mechanism, including:

Monitoring and Audit Reports: Regular reports from internal monitoring, audits, and external assessments will evaluate our performance regarding our living wage policy and identify areas for improvement.

Feedback Mechanisms: Surveys and feedback mechanisms will gather perspectives from our workforce on the impact and effectiveness of our living wage policy, enabling us to assess satisfaction levels and tailor strategies for continuous improvement.

Advocacy via Feedback: Empowering individuals to voice concerns and offer suggestions through feedback mechanisms actively engages our workforce in the pursuit of an equitable living wage policy, contributing to positive transformations in organizational practices.
policy.reviewMechanism:
To uphold the effectiveness of our Living Wage Policy, we conduct an annual review considering changes in labour laws, economic factors, and workforce needs. The Compensation and Benefits Oversight Team leads this assessment, recommending adjustments or enhancements to align with emerging regulations and best practices.

The Head of HR Manager at Indutch Pvt Ltd is responsible for the implementation, oversight, and review of this policy. The Living Wage Policy will be reviewed annually, and any updates will be communicated as necessary.
